reviews.name: Eric Englund
reviews.text:
My wife and I have used a number of realtors on previous transactions over the past 10-15 years. All of them went fine with no major issues. However, we didn't realize what we had been missing. Working with Erik was hands down the best experience we've had with a realtor, and it's not even close. From the get go, it was clear that Erik is an extremely savvy business person with a natural skill for putting deals together. He has passion for what he does and sets a high bar for his work, going beyond what I would consider to be the typical services provided by someone in his profession.

We gave Erik a task that we considered to be nearly impossible: buy a property off market contingent on selling our existing home (also off market) for a specific price that seemed like a stretch to us. To make it more complex, Erik was leaving for Europe two days later and we were heading out of state for a month. Despite these obstacles, Erik worked non stop while abroad to make the deal to come together.

Given the complexity of the transactions, we ended up speaking multiple times daily, for over a month, often in the middle of the night Europe time while Erik was on vacation. I never had difficulty reaching him, and he was forthcoming with details the whole way through. The level of service he provided was above and beyond. I truly believe our purchase/sale wouldn't have come to fruition if not for Erik's work ethic and business acumen.

Before working with Erik, we had lost on two previous offers we'd made in the same neighborhood- both to Erik and his partner Bitsa's clients. While Erik was traveling, Bitsa did a phenomenal job backing him up and being our boots on the ground. It became evident to us that if you want to buy in the Kent Woodlands, working with their team gives you a leg up. They both live there, volunteer for local community organizations, and seem to be involved in just about every transaction in the neighborhood, many of which are off market. Their expertise and intimate knowledge of the local market was hugely beneficial.

I would highly recommend working with Erik to anyone who asks. You'll be in great hands with he and his team!

reviews.name: Ashley Busacca
reviews.text:
We couldn’t have asked for a better real estate agent than Erik!

I’m originally from the Bay Area, and after living in Seattle for the past 13 years, my husband and I decided it was time to move back home. Searching for a house while living out of state meant Erik truly became our eyes and ears throughout the entire process.

To make things even more challenging, we had a very specific wish list. We needed a home that would work for our two kids and three dogs, plenty of natural light for my collection of 150+ houseplants, and a location as close as possible to my sister in Scott Valley that is safely walkable. We also warned Erik from the very beginning that we weren’t planning to move for another year and would probably be incredibly picky and slow.

Not only was he patient, attentive, and dedicated every step of the way, but what impressed us most was the depth of his knowledge. He has an incredible understanding of the market and a talent for explaining all the “nerdy numbers” in a way that helped us confidently evaluate every home. Even more valuable was his ability to help us see a property’s potential. If a house didn’t check every box, Erik could walk us through what it would take to make it work, including additions, yard renovations, permits, timelines, and realistic costs, all while keeping our budget in mind. His ability to reimagine a space is truly remarkable.

Whenever he didn’t have an answer immediately, he found it quickly. It’s clear he has strong relationships with key professionals throughout the Bay Area, and that network was invaluable during our search.

Most importantly, Erik really listened. He understood what mattered most to our family and never pressured us to settle for anything less than the right fit. Looking back, we truly don’t think we would have ended up in our dream home without his guidance and creativity in helping us see all the possibilities.

Despite the distance, he kept us informed every step of the way. His FaceTime calls and detailed video walkthroughs, even capturing nearby trails he knew we would appreciate gave me more than enough confidence to buy a home I had never even stepped foot in, while my husband was able to fly down. He made what could have been an incredibly stressful out of state home search feel seamless.

We had given ourselves a full year to find the right home because we assumed it would take that long. Erik found it in just two months and helped connect us with a home and landscape architect so we can use this additional time to make our home move in ready with our dream specs. We closed on 6/8 and I was able to finally see it person and am so over the moon about getting to move my whole family here!

Thanks to Erik’s expertise, persistence, and genuine care, we found the perfect home for our family. We are so grateful for everything he did and would work with him again without hesitation. If only he could represent the sale of our home in Seattle!

If you’re looking for an agent who truly puts his clients first, knows the Bay Area inside and out, and has the vision to help you see what’s possible without making the process feel overwhelming, Erik is your guy!

reviews.name: Ryan Darcey
reviews.text: We had a great experience working with Erik as our buyer agent, ultimately landing a home in Mill Valley, CA within just 3 months. We had very specific requirements, but Erik made the process easy and helped us find something in a notoriously competitive market with limited housing supply.

reviews.name: Christopher Westcott
reviews.text:
Erik represented the seller of the condo we recently purchased, and from start to finish, he was reliable, responsive, and genuinely easy to work with. He was flexible with our schedule, accommodating to our questions, and always followed through on what he said he'd do.

What's stood out even more is what's happened after the sale—Erik has been hands-on, making sure anything that needed refinement, fixing, or adjustment was taken care of quickly.

In a world where it's hard to find people who call you back, show up, and get it done, Erik is a delight. Highly recommend.

reviews.name: Emily Flynn
reviews.text:
Highly recommend working with Erik to sell your home and buy your next!

Erik represented us in buying our home in Marin, and we are so happy to have finally landed in our forever home thanks to him! Also, Erik sold our prior home and did a fabulous job marketing it to potential buyers, we received multiple offers above ask! We had a fabulous experience working with Erik and highly recommend him as an experienced and knowledgeable agent.

reviews.name: Richard H
reviews.text: Organized. Diligent. Conscientious. Polite. Experienced negotiator - and in the delicacy of negotiations - Erik has the skills for anything, let alone real estate brokerage. A contractor as well, if you have a house that needs help before sale, you get two-for-one. I don't think we could have found - by luck - a better realtor anywhere in the Bay Area.

reviews.name: Brittany Bafandeh
reviews.text:
We worked with Erik to sell our condo in nopa when we moved to Marin, and honestly, he went above and beyond in every possible way.

He was there for everything, coordinating painters, finding the right stagers, suggesting small but impactful upgrades that totally transformed the space without blowing the budget. I think he might have spent more time at our condo during the process than we did! It was such a relief to have someone so hands-on and invested, especially since we were busy settling into our new home at the same time.

Because of Erik’s hard work and network, we sold the condo in just a few weeks and got multiple offers the winning one was all cash and 25% over asking!! He personally showed up for every open house and made sure everything went smoothly

If you’re buying or selling, we highly recommend Erik. He’s knowledgeable, proactive, and genuinely cares he’s the kind of agent you want on your side

reviews.name: Aaron Tidman
reviews.text: Erik represented the seller/developer of the condo I ended up purchasing and he was a pleasure to work with throughout the whole process. He made himself available for extra showings, promptly answered all of our questions, and was an honest and fair negotiator. We also appreciated that Erik and the developer clearly took pride in their work and stood by their values and reputation, which gave us more faith that the new construction was high quality and any issues would be quickly remedied. The whole experience has been as easy as it gets when it comes to real estate!
